Method of Attack: Installs from %Temp% folder as a .tmp file, possibly via exploit kit
Copies itself to C:\Windows\directx.exe and creates autorun registry keys
Scans all drives for targeted file extensions and encrypts files with unique AES keys
Queries mask.php script on C2 server for list of targeted extensions
Issues WMIC command to delete Shadow Volume Copies to prevent recovery
Displays ransom note via YOUR_FILES.url file opening browser to C2 server
Periodically checks C2 server for payment to start decryption
Attack Vector: Installation from %Temp% folder as .tmp file, possibly via exploit kit
Indicators of Compromise: Registry keys HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\svchost and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\svchost pointing to C:\Windows\directx.exe
